sentence: This project studies how drought isolates parts of a river network and changes the stability of aquatic organisms living in streams.
This project connects small institutions to a faster network so researchers can use shared computing and storage resources.
This project builds statistical models that link DNA mutations to the genes they affect and finds the cells where those effects happen.
This project builds imaging tools that estimate the distance of objects from photographs without sending light into the environment.
This project builds machine learning models that simplify kinetic equations while keeping their mathematical structure.
This project builds a database of urban biodiversity from many cities and an artificial intelligence tool that forecasts how city species will change.
This project studies how the pattern of a lattice and filled-in areas inside soft gels change the way they break.
This project studies a widespread grassland plant to find out how climate change affects its movement, its ability to evolve, and its risk of extinction.
This project studies how ants change their foraging when periodical cicadas emerge and how that changes the forest community.
This project studies how two light receptors in tomato help decide the overall shape of the plant.
This project works out the evolutionary relationships of barnacles to test ideas about how their different reproductive systems evolved.
This project studies a way to make ordinary speakers work as sensors as well as sound makers, using software and signal processing.
This project uses physics and computer methods to study how the genome, cells and tissues of living systems are organized and controlled.
This project studies stream deposits in the ice-free valleys of Antarctica to learn how meltwater and climate changed in the past.
This project builds teams of small and growing robots that help each other move through collapsed buildings during search and rescue.
